name: Moth Jump Rope
alt_view: Sketchy GIF of an anthro moth — she's wearing a T-shirt, some baggy jeans, and tennis shoes. She's jumping rope; doing some two-legged hops, and then some one-legged hops, subtly bouncing from side to side.

name: Ribbit Stroll
alt_view: Color drawing of Ribbit, from The Amazing Digital Circus — a tall, green anthro frog with a lighter-green countershaded torso, eyelashes, and a red bow tie. She's taking a leisurely stroll through an orange park, with leaves falling around her.

name: Cooling Off
alt_view: Sketchy doodle of an anthro moth. She's leaning back against a brick wall, stretching one of her legs up and grabbing her heel with her hand. She's wearing a tanktop, some jorts, and running shoes; and is drinking from a cup of assorted beverage, through a bendy straw. She's staring at the viewer with a perceptibly annoyed expression.

name: Aggie Moth
alt_view: Doodle of an anthro moth. They're standing, and looking off to the side with a sorta ambivalent-lookin' expression. They're wearing a slightly baggy T-shirt, tucked into a pair of waist-high denim shorts.

name: Spaceball
alt_view: Very messy doodle of a green room. Inside, there's a blue figure, a pipe and a hole on the floor; and a window with some sort of space creature sitting on the windowsill.

name: Hard at Work
alt_view: Doodle of an anthro moth, laying out on the floor. She's wearing a T-shirt and jorts, and has a lazy expression with her tongue sticking out. Her outstretched arms are typing and mousing on an apple laptop in front of her, which is casting light on her face. There's an open can of soda and bag of chips laid out in arm's reach, as well.

name: Augustravaganza 2026
alt_view: Key art for Augustravaganza 2026. It's a top-down view of a beach, with a wave breaking over the top. Inside the wave, there's some text: "2026 Augustravaganza! Playdate Community Sale. Over 60 games on sale! Runs from August 1st through August 7th, pacific time." On the beach, key arts of various Playdate games are buried in the sand. There's text that reads: "Visit Catalog on your Playdate! Or, head to... play.date/games/tags/on-sale"

name: Groove Drummer
alt_view: Drummer girl from Rhythm Heaven Groove. She's got her arms crossed, and is staring straight down the barrel of the camera with piercingly-blue eyes. (Like that one meme.)

name: Gay Machines
alt_view: Two-panel comic doodle featuring an anthro cat (wearing a big sweater and skirt, with a bow on his head), and an anthro mouse (with ear piercings and a business-casual outfit). Panel 1: The two are facing eachother, with the camera at a side angle. The mouse says "it's pride month, cat. you know what that means." The cat is holding a block, and has a slightly confused look on his face. He replies "huh. what" Panel 2: The mouse is walking away from the cat silently; with a smug expression and his hands behind his back. The cat is more confused now, having set down the block, and is saying "do you want me to make like. gay machines? what?". The mouse only responds with ":3".

name: Black (Among Us)
alt_view: Doodle of Black, a character from Among Us. They're a short being, in a very-dark-gray astronaut suit with a reflective oval-shaped visor; wearing a black choker with spikes. They've got a colorful binky in their mouth and are giving an emphatic thumbs up via disembodied hand.

name: Crank Boy Catalog Key Art #2
alt_view: 1-bit art reminiscent of the original Game Boy's box art, with a stylized shiny Playdate being played by equally-shiny robotic hands in a radical grid background. Flanking the left side is text that reads "CRANK BOY — FULL-SPEED GB EMULATOR", and there's a banner on the screen reading "4 games included!". In the lower-right corner, there's a brief list of app features — "Add your own collection!", "Download homebrew in-app", "Widescreen for select titles", "Download hacks/softpatches".

name: Crank Boy Catalog Key Art
alt_view: 1-bit art depicting a sort of hybrid Playdate/Game Boy, with a crank on the side. The screen says "CRANK BOY" in big, bold letters — along the crank, there's text that reads "full speed GB emulator".

name: Pesto Metaphor
alt_view: A giant red gummy bear. There's a 100x magnifier zooming in on a normal-sized me, gnawing rabidly on the foot. It looks unchanged.

name: Amelia N.
alt_view: Amelia N. from the Nintendo Switch News section. She's a polite-looking lady with blue hair and a bright-yellow headband, spherical red earrings, and an earpiece microphone. She's wearing a long orange sweater that extends down to her ankles, and dark-brown boots. She's sitting around on the Nintendo Switch HOME Menu, with a bunch of icons surrounding her.

name: Minecraft Alex
alt_view: Drawing of Alex from Minecraft, in some kind of dark cave. She's got red/orange hair, with most of the length tied up in a braid running down her shoulder. She's wearing a green shirt, baggy brown pants and gray boots; and holding a big pickaxe behind her with both hands. She seems exhausted, with one leg kicked back against a nearby block. A Creeper is looking in from the distance.

name: Spilled Mushrooms Expansion Pack 3 Art
alt_view: Promotional art for "Mechanical Mushrooms". There's text underneath that reads "Spilled Mushrooms Expansion Pack 3 — New critters! New areas! Free update for current owners; full price increased to $9. https://play.date/g/mushrooms". Along the sides, a crab and hippo face off against roboticized versions of themselves.

name: Waiting
alt_view: Sonic the Hedgehog, standing in a stylized Green Hill Zone. His arms are crossed and he's tapping his foot impatiently, as he tends to do.

name: Dionicio/Diana Ref Sheet
alt_view: Character ref sheet for Dionicio/Diana, a goat therian with dark brown long hair and big slightly-curved horns; wearing a green cowbell collar, a dark-gray hoodie with a design printed on the corner, and a short green skirt. There's some character info: she/he/they pronouns, bisexual/bigender/polyamorous, birthday 09.11.2003, 5'10" (178cm). "Silly goat therian", "Very kind & friendly", "Loves being gay with friends; will always try to help them out no matter what". "extra-sensitive horns (you can rub them to calm her down)", "slight fangs; green tongue".

name: Stick Fall (Procreate Dreams Animation Test)
alt_view: A panning camera move — below a blue sky, some non-descript dark blue mounds move with parallax. a stick figure is running across the frontmost one, stumbling and falling onto the floor.

name: 2025 Playdate Community Awards: RowBot Rally
alt_view: Consider nominating "RowBot Rally" at the 2025 Playdate Community Awards, for "2025 Playdate GOTY", "The CRANKY Award", "Accomplishment in Accessibility", "Best Action Game", "Best Adventure Game", "Best Narrative Game", "Outstanding Visual Achievement (SDK)", and "Best Launch Experience".

name: 2025 Playdate Community Awards: Cloudburst
alt_view: Consider nominating "Cloudburst" at the 2025 Playdate Community Awards, for "Accomplishment in Accessibility", "Best App or Knickknack", "Best Sound Design", and "Outstanding Technical Achievement (SDK)".

name: 2025 Playdate Community Awards: Mission LunaTrix
alt_view: Consider nominating "Mission LunaTrix" at the 2025 Playdate Community Awards, for "Best Arcade Game", "Best Soundtrack", and "Best Sound Design".

name: 2025 Playdate Community Awards: Bona Fido/Traffic Jam
alt_view: Consider nominating "Bona Fido" and "Traffic Jam" at the 2025 Playdate Community Awards, for "Best Arcade Game".

name: Squashed Moth
alt_view: Sketch of an anthro moth squashed down to about two inches tall. She looks disheveled.

name: Echo Drop! Catalog Key Art
name_situ: View the game in Playdate Catalog

name: Pixel RowBot
alt_view: A very small, 1-bit drawing of a robot wearing a fisher hat. It looks a bit goofy as it stands.

name: Epiphyll
alt_view: Humanoid character with orange, semi-long hair — she's wearing a long-sleeve burgundy jacket with white gloves, a white scarf, dark pants with orange shoes, and a pair of goggles on her forehead. She's floating around in space.

name: Leveraging Your Cat
alt_view: Sketchy pixel doodle. A cat sits patiently on the weighted end of a cartoony teeter-totter. An anthro moth is in the midst of an impending fucking suplex elbow drop onto the other end.

name: Liam
alt_view: Low-ish angle drawing of an orange anthro cat (he/they), staring towards the camera with a smiling expression. They're squatting down near the ground; one hand planted on the floor behind them to keep themselves balanced, and their other hand held up to their face with a 'telephone' gesture. They're wearing a purple tee with a design of yellow and green fruit slices, a black-and-white striped long-sleeve undershirt, dark-gray jeans with a tear on one knee and black-and-red sneakers. They also have a red flower in their hair. The background is teal and green with a grid pattern.

name: Crank Defense Force Catalog Key Art
name_situ: View the game in Playdate Catalog

name: Orchid
alt_view: Humanoid character with one visible eye, white hair and a flat pony-tail; wearing a yellow and purple split hoodie with oversized sleeves and purple-blue pants. They're doing a backflip through space.

name: Spilled Mushrooms Expansion Pack 2 Art
alt_view: Promotional art for "Mythical Mushrooms". There's text underneath that reads "Spilled Mushrooms Expansion Pack 2 — New critters! New areas! Achievements! Puzzle sharing! Free update for current owners; full price increased to $8. https://play.date/g/mushrooms". Along the sides, a unicorn, minotaur, and jackalope run off carrying baskets of mushrooms.

name: Augustravaganza 2025
alt_view: Flat, bubbly promotional poster with a yellow background and green accents. "2025 Playdate Community Augustravaganza! Over 60 games on sale, across all genres and styles! Runs from August 1st to August 7th, pacific time." There's a link to the catalog sale page, and a variety of Playdate game thumbnails lining the bottom of the frame.

name: Graintouch Moth
alt_view: Picture of a waving moth doodled in the Graintouch app — it gives the appearance of a printed design, complete with grainy texture and ink misalignment.

name: Quick Moth-Tuber
alt_view: A digitally-created paper sketch of a moth with a neutral expression, crudely cut out and attached to a popsicle stick. Her mouth is closed.
alt_alt1: A digitally-created paper sketch of a moth with a neutral expression, crudely cut out and attached to a popsicle stick. Her mouth is open.

name: That Moth with the Glasses
alt_view: an array of moths wearing glasses. in the center, she stands politely. on the left, she's pushing up her lenses in a way that reflects the light, kind of like every annoying anime character. there's text pointing to her there that reads "about to be so incorrect". on the right, she's fitted in nostalgia critic attire, screaming about a moth credit card

name: Spilled Mushrooms Expansion Pack 1 Art
alt_view: Promotional art for "More Mushrooms". There's text underneath that reads "Spilled Mushrooms Expansion Pack 1 — New critters! New areas! Free update for current owners; full price increased to $7. https://play.date/g/mushrooms". Along the sides, a cow, donkey, turkey, and toucan run off carrying baskets of mushrooms.

name: Treena
alt_view: Character from Jackbox game Champ'd Up. They're wearing a green fighting costume, complete with christmas tree helmet that completely covers the head.

name: Doodle Moth
alt_view: Loose scribble of an anthro moth standing around; she has very scribbly hands and insane digitigrade legs.

name: Community Service
alt_view: Doodle of an anthro moth performing community service in an orange jumpsuit. She's speaking something to someone nearby.

name: Trackminia Catalog Key Art
alt_view: A car drifts towards the camera along a bridge high up in the sky, during sunset. The word "Trackminia" is displayed across the top.

name: Tiny Moth's First Day at the Office
Soundstage Moth
alt_view: Drawing of an anthro moth seen from behind, squatting and throwing a peace sign towards the camera on some kind of green screen soundstage.

name: Not Safe For Work
alt_view: Doodle of an anthro moth, balancing precariously on a swivel chair.

name: Rude!
alt_view: Doodle of an anthro moth, throwing up a middle finger and sticking her tongue out.
